purpose: Diagnose why episode v1 failed: compare rendered scene exposure against the released real-world fixtures the checkpoint was demonstrated on.

measurements.label: habitat apartment_1 raw render, lighting=scene (episode v1 model input)

conclusion: Raw render is ~3x darker than the distribution the checkpoint was demonstrated on. Habitat default lighting made it worse, so v2 applied a per-frame auto-exposure gain to the model input only, emulating a real RGB-D camera. Saved observation PNGs are unmodified.
